decisions.physicalWaxFormat: 16 baseball cards plus 1 Magic Motion trivia card; 36 packs per box.
decisions.vcsPackFormat: 17 total slots; guaranteed Magic Motion leaves 16 base cards normally. Young Superstars hits replace another base slot.
decisions.rackExclusiveConversion: One Young Superstars card per 48-base-card rack pack. Convert 48/16=3 wax-equivalent packs to 1:3 VCS packs. This is an intentional approximation, not historical wax odds.
decisions.subsets: Rookie Prospects 621-651 and 1988 Season Highlights 652-660 remain in complete Base.
decisions.variations: Seven extra error/variation rows collapse to corrected/later b states, including airbrushed Paul Gibson.
decisions.exclusions: Promos and separate Rookie/Traded, Scoremasters, Hottest 100 and Young Superstars Set 2 boxed products excluded. Griffey Jr. is not in the flagship base checklist.
decisions.magicMotion: 56 annual trivia cards span 1932-1987; historical teams and event captions are source data. #50 Player Strike (1981) intentionally has no team; apply requires --allow-pending-teams.

productSets.name: Magic Motion: A Year to Remember
